entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support including indexes to inlined enumerables passed to queries #37308
  • Unexpected behavior expanding a back-navigation that contains derived entities with non-optional complex type where all properties are nullable #37304

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #37309
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #37307

Merged

  • Merge release/9.0-staging to release/9.0 #37306
  • [release/9.0] Fix snapshot generation to capture column type for JSON columns #37294
    Servicing-approved, 9.0.12
  • [release/10.0] Fix NullReferenceException when scaffolding named default constraints #37243
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [release/10.0] Fix TableSharingConcurrencyTokenConvention to skip JSON-mapped entities #37286
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • Merge release/8.0-staging to release/8.0 #37305
  • [release/10.0] Fix snapshot generation to capture column type for JSON columns #37284
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [release/10.0] Always generate HasDiscriminator with type argument and property name in snapshot #37242
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2

Updated

  • Fix nullable complex property with PropertyValues.ToObject() and SetValues() creating instance instead of null #37302
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37285
  • Fallback to OPENJSON with many parameters #37234
  • Add cosmos db complex properties #37298
